notes.title: Progress Report: December-January
notes.notes:
Gather round, brave souls and skyward seekers, for I bring tidings of our December dispatch, a compendium of advancements and marvels that have transformed our aerial tapestry into an even more resplendent realm. Allow me to unfurl the scroll of our latest exploits:

[b]Refinery Sprites and Tilesets:[/b] Behold, the industrious heart of our world now pulsates with new life! We've crafted exquisite refinery sprites and tilesets, a testament to the ingenuity of airship engineers and alchemists alike. Marvel at the intricate machinery and labyrinthine pipes, where steam and strategy blend in harmonious symphony.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/9ee5138eb499910b3e4dca1028da82e929990792.jpg[/img]

[b]Jungle Map Updates:[/b] The verdant jungles throb with a deeper mystery. We've enriched our jungles with layers of secrets and perils, turning every leaf and vine into a story waiting to be discovered. Tread lightly, for these updates promise both beauty and danger in equal measure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/319defc60b24fd60623974c17fb8e06dd3c33895.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/eae54c7db1e50ff0eb232c028b204f6ca4e619ff.png[/img]

[b]Palace Maps - Observatory and Imperial High Command:[/b] Explore the Observatory and Imperial High Command, each a marvel of design and strategic importance. Here, the fate of empires is charted among the stars, and commands are issued that ripple across the skies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/d4e44725e967236b1d541fa68eb96da9898e9e68.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/674b02af384941a4ead52c3701212f588c788660.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/b5e0f0d1a89bbc21cfdd6e9d480ae537716bd9d1.jpg[/img]

[b]Undead Castle Map - Ruined Village:[/b] Venture into the shadows with the Undead Castle Map, featuring the Ruined Village. Amidst these forlorn ruins, echoes of the past mingle with the groans of the restless dead. Light your torches; bravery alone will not suffice here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/5ea447cb8fc37b09430f3284e842843bedd3ff0a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/158334a7ed9261cc1c2da2d87388f79890b8eaf8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/f8bcd36a9f2d09c16894b4db3da34820e821ae37.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/967b1c471fbd2938bdc61c371773a7cad4b38afb.png[/img]

[b]AI Updates:[/b] The AI has been refined for a more cunning and challenging experience. Engage with ranged Troopers, whose tactics have evolved, and melee Zombies, whose relentless pursuit has become even more fearsome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/38a16f5aaf64f62205716adc4e26d45576cd7238.png[/img]

In conclusion, this December update is a cornucopia of wonders and enhancements (though not as much as it could have been, as we spent some family time), each crafted with the utmost care and attention to detail. As you embark on your journeys, remember: in our realm, every choice leads to a new story, every path to a new adventure.

Yours in boundless exploration,
Truecrabs

[i]"To the skies, where every horizon is a new beginning, and every cloud a canvas for dreams!"[/i]

notes.title: Progress Report: November 2023
notes.notes:
Esteemed Adventurers and Skyward Souls,

As November's winds weave through the North, with leaves in golden array, and the Southern skies boil in a tempest of sweltering heat and Christmas beetles, I, with a flourish of the pen, bring forth our latest grandiose update. This month, we invite you to delve into untold mysteries and face uncharted challenges in our aerial realm.

[b]Jungle Temples: Labyrinths Lost in Time[/b]
In the heart of sprawling jungles, ancient Mayan-inspired temples rise, echoing the whispers of a forgotten civilization. Not mere relics, these sanctuaries are mazes brimming with secrets and treasures, awaiting those bold enough to uncover their hidden splendors.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/581dd867ee540dd48749eecda422d8a0242ce37b.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/cfce69bad0fa87c47b23cbd4a9f0d54199922737.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/6f745203069367d523ffd6727a75c89f14805763.png[/img][/center]

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/de30db6055cd5a36aea30827e96f7ce774c6a306.png[/img][/center]

[b]The Cannibal Natives: A Formidable Faction[/b]
Beneath the jungle canopy, the Cannibal Natives, both enigmatic and fearsome, emerge as a new, formidable presence. Engage in "diplomacy" within their untamed lands, where peril and promise intertwine.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/f8d902ec54c154cfac27b1a7a835bd576b0f976f.png[/img][/center]

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/455cf7bdf9e966cbc061d1f951d377d402cb8069.png[/img][/center]

[b]Imperial Faction's Opulent Palaces[/b]
Beyond the jungle's embrace, enter the Imperial Faction's Rich Palaces. Within these halls, luxury intertwines with intrigue, where whispered words can shift the balance of power. Navigate this realm of elegance and shadow, where every corner holds a story.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/a8d8dc89edb932ecc72fe5b58356d7a33c566b4f.png[/img][/center]

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/01b918ceb6f6254e7cecd785f7daf19339eb29bf.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/42dc870eb48730bc9bc9f4ea9dd582c2882cc340.png[/img][/center]

[b]Enhancements and Equilibrium[/b]
With Allan's masterful art and my coding craft, we've stitched a myriad of enhancements into our world. This update features significant bug fixes and AI advancements for a smoother journey. Weapon balance tweaks ensure each encounter is exhilarating and fair.

[b]In Summary[/b]
This November, the skies beckon anew. Embark into our realm where ancient temples, tribal drums, and imperial elegance await. Ready your airship, assemble your crew, and etch your story in the annals of the skies.

Yours in boundless adventure,
Truecrabs

[i]"To the skies, where legends soar and history is written by the bold!"[/i]

notes.title: Progress Report: October 2023
notes.notes:
[b]Gothic Gardens[/b]
Descend into the steampunk abyss with our October update. Here, the macabre waltz of undead foliage meets the cold precision of mechanized malice. Haunted greenhouses, new abominable adversaries, and cunningly concealed traps lie in wait among the ruins of a steampunk dream turned nightmare.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/bbca693c450865e68cdd7dd45e16b8385d010fa0.jpg[/img][/center]

[b]Undead Greenhouse Expansion[/b]
Tread carefully amidst the Undead Greenhouse where botanical monstrosities take root. Doodads twisted by death's eternal embrace await, where each bloom may be your last sight.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/9ce5de7f715232a8d43fc631704a6c9dc511ee56.jpg[/img][/center]

[b]Castle Garden's Malevolent Bloom[/b]
Within the Castle Garden's corrupted earth, dread and beauty are bedfellows. Here, noble paths have withered, giving way to doodads that whisper of decay and despair.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/48f505d9a3b2c7560089adc88313ebff214729de.png[/img][/center]

[b]Castle Interior: A Facade of Splendor[/b]
Step into Castle Interiors laced with opulent deceit. Among the lavish doodads and furnishings, shadows cast by the flickering flame unveil game objects that may harbor unspeakable horrors.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/9a404e3337a992ec3cd637c99d8eb2cbf113d9ea.png[/img][/center]

[b]Airship Interior: War in the Wings[/b]
The revamped Airship Interior tileset heralds a claustrophobic ballet of death. Navigate through the menacing innards, amongst doodads and game objects that breathe life into the art of aerial combat.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/5d31547aaeb07e19f938832ec8f33aaac66bbf10.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/dea5749310e1043150ec4e1391eb29bdb7ee0239.jpg[/img][/center]

[b]Enhanced Carnage: Better Gore, Better Flames[/b]
Feast your senses on the enhanced gore and flames. Now, each blow lands with a visceral satisfaction, and fire consumes with a hunger more voracious and visually enthralling.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/6a32f9f325e44932982b2d886128587575b8ce34.png[/img][/center]

[b]Destructible Doodads: A World Unraveling[/b]
Lay siege to your surroundings with destructible doodads. Shatter, splinter, and sunder the world around you, leaving only the echoes of obliteration in your wake.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/d1cdbaf8f30fb1c89c474e8e15de6b2641197a11.jpg[/img][/center]

[b]Bathouse Interior: Eerie Immersion[/b]
Dare to dip into the Bathouse Interior tileset. Here, each droplet of water echoes amidst the murk, and the stone breathes with the dampness of dread.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/9a4bc44838036b1e27d06ab4d82c5498cf009c14.jpg[/img][/center]

[b]Traps Galore: A Gauntlet of Grief[/b]
A new array of traps awaits: spike traps, circular saws, pendulums, crushers, and rolling boulders. Each step could be a dance with death, every corner a cruel end.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/5ff5c52cc3c5abdf27f6e302dd2deb0c5a278928.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/6ad184f9077d13fda5e34abce65fed16ea80fb34.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/569a1e459e2b31d40c5e1a3813d0c160548d97fb.png[/img][/center]

[b]Dungeon Interior: Where Shadows Dwell[/b]
Delve into the Dungeon Interior, now replete with tilesets, doodads, and game objects that craft a narrative of peril with each cobweb-strewn corner and skeleton-littered cell.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/73ea5dfe89de172190598212d2ef3de730d0c9c0.png[/img][/center]

[b]Arachnid Adversaries: Giant Spiders[/b]
Face the skittering terror of Giant Spiders, capable of leaping and running down the bravest souls, ready to weave their deadly dance upon unsuspecting prey.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/9f997d71df5b39fd71df4a76b5f103283586ac1a.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/2502b9801987cbb4ca4a7efa6f017cf558071f4e.png[/img][/center]

[b]The Gorg Monster: Floating Fury[/b]
Beware the Gorg Monster, a grotesque floating head with eyes that sear the soul and an energy orb that seeks to extinguish the light of life.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/d34ceed121b3f386bb12e34f85a159ea16f49915.png[/img][/center]

[b]Zombie Variants: The Undead Evolve[/b]
Encounter new breeds of horror with an array of zombie variants, including the explosive finish of the Exploding Zombie—a literal walking nightmare.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/b33fff319df7c286a275c2b2d709b45d7808e907.png[/img][/center]

[b]Laboratory Interior: Science & Sacrilege[/b]
Enter the Laboratory Interior, where tilesets, doodads, and game objects tell tales of experiments too sinister for the sane world.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/5c9999026252b68fdeb744723cdb0272bdd1d356.jpg[/img][/center]

[b]Jungle Exterior: Lush Labyrinths[/b]
The Jungle Exterior beckons with its lush, treacherous expanses, filled with doodads and game objects that hold both the promise of adventure and the peril of the unknown.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/fc8eab988c23e46a77716409bcf82984d62acd12.jpg[/img][/center]

[b]Infested Undead & Garden Sorrows[/b]
The Cultist Undead roam amidst the newly animated garden doodads. Beware the swaying plants—what secrets do they shroud within their supple stems?

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/d898facce71eb634991dee9718d1af65c7976bf7.png[/img][/center]

[b]Landmines & Exploding Spores: The Flora Fights Back[/b]
Mind your step as landmines and exploding plant spores add a new layer of danger to your traversal. The garden is not passive; it preys.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/cd257cc88c7e6a517a0fc25ea94971eb0af8fb84.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/9189b292c4f33d7afb1c626da1119befeb90427c.png[/img][/center]

[b]Volcano Exterior: A Fiery Frontier[/b]
Challenge your fate in the Volcano Exterior. Here, tilesets, doodads, and game objects are bathed in the glow of molten peril, and every path is a potential pyre.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/0f737e285eaa26243cd321618b56b7b9665854b3.jpg[/img][/center]

In this world of Gothic Gardens and Mechanical Menaces, every new addition weaves into the existing tapestry of terror, creating an ever-evolving narrative of despair and darkness. Adventure with caution, for beauty in this realm is but a thin veil over the face of horror.

notes.title: Progress Report: September 2023
notes.notes:
[b]New Player Airships![/b]
Elevate your aerial adventures with three new player airships: Orion, Paladin, and Rapture. Each brings unique capabilities and aesthetic details.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/83cf7fb1aed938380001d5bdb1ac62cbba6d9747.png[/img][/center]


[b]The Orion![/b]
Cruise the skies in the Orion, a heavily-armored airship featuring a unique zone-based design for specialized control. The ultimate in aerial fortitude!

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/0aa10612ab5ade408c72bfcddc362fedeaa52e7d.png[/img][/center]


[b]The Rapture![/b]
Take command of the Rapture—an open-deck airship with five turrets. High firepower meets high risk; watch your step and let the cannons roar!

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/0c9a6011340ef70fd1d096fc9833f66edd978d20.png[/img][/center]


[b]The Paladin![/b]
Set sail with the Paladin, the ultimate broadside vessel featuring a hardened deck house and ample crew. Unleash devastating firepower in style!

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/fbdda14d6e513a58970a41c4f335855cedbe2702.png[/img][/center]


[b]New Enemy Characters - Imperial Navy[/b]
Prepare to face a formidable foe! The Imperial Navy brings advanced technology and ruthless tactics. Are you up for the challenge?

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/6c00faa86648f417e9416164d3d0aebb95638ed0.png[/img][/center]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/b090ca44667aea61e6bbfa77b243be6f07e3fb3c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/e3a5facab8e9d4ddc2705a630490eff6681566c8.png[/img]


[b]New Terrains[/b]
Explore the mystical Undead Castle and the ethereal Undead Gardens. These terrains add new dimensions to your quests and offer new challenges.

[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/66b67d1a1b72942db62b16436084de47c39523c2.png[/img][/center]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/5a832fcc1ca461300b53794f2d608d305f07fcad.png[/img]


[b]New Hazard - Mutated Plants[/b]
Beware the Mutated Plants that now inhabit our world! These hazardous flora can wreak havoc on unsuspecting adventurers, so tread carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/455640233aed645d00782824c6e59b9c98eb15ea.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to expand our steampunk universe!

notes.title: Progress Report: August 2023
notes.notes:
[b]New Explosive Airship Damage Points[/b]
Prepare to witness the exhilarating spectacle of enemy airships erupting into flames and meeting their doom in a blaze of glory with our newly introduced damage points system. Every hit counts, and every explosion is a visual treat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/18766980632cc3a27c8ee31e17aef76c6e61df2a.png[/img]


[b]Weapon Mount Sound Effects[/b]
A full arsenal of 48 weapon mounts are here to spice up the battleground with their unique sound effects. Each mount comes with a distinct sound signature that adds depth and realism to your combats.


[b]Updated Weapon Projectile and Hit FX[/b]
We've ramped up the impact of your weapons with enhanced projectile and hit effects for all 48 variants. Feel the raw power as each weapon unleashes havoc with improved visuals and immersive feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/596421ff8c910874c42f1fa07a29ebbb69cf0905.png[/img]


[b]Burning Hull Breaches and Enhanced Graphical Variety[/b]
Experience heightened tension and urgency as burning hull breaches now adorn the war-torn airships. The additional graphical variety ensures a visually rich and intense battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/66d9af802325c53b0e9440e9de5218bedd19191b.png[/img]


[b]More Explosion Sound Effects[/b]
Immerse yourself deeper with more explosion sound effects that bring a rich and layered auditory experience to every fiery encounter in the skies of Illwind.


[b]Enemy Airships Equipped with Weapon Mounts[/b]
The enemy fleets are back, now more formidable than ever with equipped weapon mounts on all airships, introducing a new layer of strategy and excitement to your battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/652b1c961b2a9c15b95a09f9a7f8d4e23601b316.png[/img]


[b]Navmesh Fixes for a Smoother Journey[/b]
Navigate through the Illwind world with ease thanks to the comprehensive navmesh fixes applied to both airships and generated maps, ensuring a glitch-free and fluid journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/ea2ac58c73167d077cac562c197fe6e898795422.png[/img]


[b]Ghost/Undead Turret Graphics[/b]
Dive into the eerie and mysterious world of the undead with our latest graphical updates to the ghost and undead turret graphics, a spine-chilling yet visually arresting addition to the Illwind universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/db94b31210c39184fad188880e37ea64b96406dc.png[/img]


[b]Further UI Enhancements[/b]
We continue to polish and refine the user interface, introducing a series of updates for a more intuitive and pleasant navigation experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/f52247ab1109fb7a6c3514556f53fa433762c9e4.png[/img]


[b]More Bug Fixes for a Seamless Experience[/b]
We’ve squashed even more bugs in this update, paving the way for a smoother and more stable gaming experience.


[b]Beginning the Journey in the Undead Settlements[/b]
In our ongoing commitment to expanding the Illwind world, we have initiated the development of the Undead Settlements. Stay tuned for a haunting new adventure that awaits in the land of the dead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/fc2bfc318049e4cd019fa12ca46ee9d4884374cd.png[/img]


[quote]The world of Illwind continues to evolve with each update, offering deeper immersion and exhilarating adventures. We are excited to share these improvements with you, and as always, we remain eager to hear your feedback. Until next time, brave adventurers![/quote]

notes.title: Progress Report: July 2023
notes.notes:
Venture through the revamped taverns and shipyards, experience our newly enhanced UI and menu options, and prepare for high octane airship action in our latest update. Engage in combat with improved weapon projectiles, mounted weapons, and other exciting changes to our steampunk-inspired world. With the introduction of the Hobo airships and the implementation of ambient soundscapes, the thrilling journey in Illwind has just got even better. We have put our heart and soul into this update, striving to provide you with the best possible gaming experience. 


[b]Shipyard and Airship Selection[/b]
Indulge in our updated shipyard graphics and airship selection scene. Choose the perfect airship for your journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/d3cd3c0fef30538a9089e5a6e5776514a8d7091d.png[/img]


[b]Tavern Update and Character Selection[/b]
With our revamped taverns, select your favourite characters for your exciting voyage in the world of Illwind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/5b5fe3b6007bf845c16c48ea5be2c66ae31144aa.png[/img]

Experience our enhanced User Interface and options menu, including adjustments in sound, gameplay, interface and graphics settings for a smoother gameplay experience.

[b]Gore Art Updates[/b]
Enjoy our updated gore art and performance improvements for even more visceral carnage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/9e6a08811cbc82acb90fafb8ec484657ec30fdd0.png[/img]


[b]Improved Clouds[/b]
Marvel at our beautiful, improved cloud backgrounds adding more life to your adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/ac0529a1824a7ba5ed60446b5e6fd5d252328b6d.png[/img]


[b]Bug Fixes and Shader Optimisations[/b]
Experience smoother gameplay with our latest bug fixes and shader optimisations.

[b]Menu Scenes: Engine Room and Theater[/b]
To further flesh out our updated UI, enjoy new ambient scenes for our menus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/194aafb0bae64597aca3713b784af95292ee205d.jpg[/img]


[b]Mounted Weapons and Weapon FX[/b]
Engage in exhilarating combats with our new mounted weapons, improved weapon projectiles FX, and weapon hit FX.

[u]Tier 1:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/bbe29b846cf5107da3326c646e6548db082b7dc7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/f64858045851c7dddd484be056f203ecefe72189.png[/img]


[b]Hobo Airships and Ambient Soundscapes[/b]
Prepare to encounter the intriguing Hobo airships and immerse yourself deeper with our newly implemented ambient soundscapes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/0cee1a63ad8c888b1c9fe51d40f203e7bd690e55.jpg[/img]


[quote]Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to expand and refine our steampunk world! Until next time![/quote]

notes.title: Progress Report: June 2023
notes.notes:
Prepare to navigate through the thrilling Port maps, marvel at the dynamic window glow, face spectral entities, and battle against the new Hobo faction in our inaugural update. Immerse yourself deeper with enhanced NPC behaviours thanks to updated Behaviour Trees and Navmesh optimizations. Experience the revamp in airship dynamics and Imperial Navy might. And finally, lose yourself in the visually enhanced world, with improved Clouds, Shipyard, and Tavern sprites. The two of us have been hard at work for a month crafting this update, designed to bring you a more immersive, thrilling, and steampunk-filled airship experience. Prepare for the voyage!


[b]Docking![/b]
No longer are you bound to your airship! Experience missions and adventures on your own two (non-rendered) feet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/849b9b7c0955bbd874dddf38539d9f1693f85a82.png[/img]



[b]Port Maps![/b]
We've created entirely new maps for you to explore! Navigate the thrilling and dangerous Pirate Ports as well as skybound Rigs, extracting gas for the Empire, riddled with hidden treasures and perilous threats, all generated by Wave Function Collapse for dynamic off-airship adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148215/1578569dce9a8583f881b20ac9613c1dfe344c20.png[/img]



[b]Dynamic Window Glow and Day/Night Cycle[/b]
